name: Village of Barovia — Town Square (E3)
ambient: (SOURCE-GROUNDED AREA — PLACEHOLDER PROSE) Adapted from Expedition to Castle Ravenloft, Chapter 2, area E3. Fog, barricades, and a square holding against the dead. This is a bounded excerpt, not the full village.

npcs.name: Ashlyn, Undead Hunter
npcs.look: (SOURCE-ADAPTED, PLACEHOLDER PROSE) A human woman in shining half-plate stands near the square's center. A holy symbol is emblazoned on the armor; her longsword is still drawn.

objects.name: Breached Eastern Barricade
objects.look: (SOURCE-ADAPTED, PLACEHOLDER PROSE) Repurposed doors, tables, and scrap lumber form a rough barricade. A ten-foot gap opens onto the eastern street.

interactions.label: Help repair the barricade
interactions.success_text: (SOURCE-ADAPTED) With the square clear, you brace the gap with fresh lumber and fallen boards. The barricade holds.

effects.text: The eastern barricade is repaired. The square is no longer open to the street.
(SOURCE-ADAPTED) The gap is wide enough for two zombies abreast. Beyond it, the fog hides the eastern street.

objects.name: Village Well
objects.look: (SOURCE-ADAPTED, PLACEHOLDER PROSE) A low stone wall surrounds the village well. The shaft drops into cold darkness.

effects.text: (SOURCE-ADAPTED) The well is still. A bucket rope hangs slack against the stone; no one has drawn water here today.

objects.name: Bildrath's Mercantile
objects.look: (SOURCE-ADAPTED, PLACEHOLDER PROSE) A shop facing the square. Its windows are boarded; the door is shut and barred from within.

effects.text: (SOURCE-ADAPTED) No answer. Behind the boards, something heavy shifts, then stops. The shop stays closed while the square is unsafe.

objects.name: Blood of the Vine Tavern
objects.look: (SOURCE-ADAPTED, PLACEHOLDER PROSE) A rambling building on the square. The sign is askew, and the windows are shuttered. A thin line of smoke rises from the chimney.

effects.text: (SOURCE-ADAPTED) A muffled voice tells you to wait. The door remains barred while the dead are in the square.

objects.name: Demo Waystone (Developer Route)
objects.look: (DEVELOPER DEMO ROUTE — NOT CANONICAL GEOGRAPHY) A chalk-marked waystone placed here so the demo can return to the staging map.

interactions.label: DEMO: Return to the staging area
interactions.success_text: (DEVELOPER DEMO) You step back to the non-canonical staging area.

effects.text: (SOURCE-ADAPTED ENCOUNTER) The eastern barricade gives way. Ashlyn shouts for aid as the dead push through the gap.
